column1: # bench/winloss.py's classification: source, query or test, shape class. ClickBench is classified from its SQL text
# (winloss.py); speedtest1 by test number; TPC-H by query. Classes:
#   point        point lookup by key (one row)
#   short        short one-shot statements (constants, tiny scans), where per-statement overhead dominates
#   range        range scan over an index (short ranges, many executions)
#   scan-expr    filtered or expression-heavy scan (WHERE on unindexed columns, LIKE, function calls per row)
#   agg          aggregation / GROUP BY over a scan
#   join         multi-table join (usually with an aggregate on top)
#   subquery     correlated subqueries, EXISTS / NOT EXISTS, IN (subquery), CTEs feeding a filter
#   sort         ORDER BY without LIMIT (a full sort)
#   compute      compute-heavy: recursive CTEs, window functions, arithmetic in loops
#   write        INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE / DDL (qc doesn't run them; differences are side effects or noise)
